topic: Decide which laptop model to standardize on for the two of us

scenario.topic: Decide which laptop model to standardize on for the two of us
scenario.opening_question: What matters more to us in a laptop: raw performance, portability, battery life, or cost?

options.name: Dell XPS 13 9310 Laptop
options.upside: Excellent portability with a premium build and long battery life.
options.tradeoff: Limited ports and integrated graphics may slow down video editing.
options.concern: Some users find the keyboard layout cramped for long coding sessions.
options.best_for: Prioritizing portability and battery life while staying under budget.

options.name: Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 2
options.upside: Robust build quality with a comfortable keyboard and solid performance.
options.tradeoff: Heavier and shorter battery life compared to ultraportables.
options.concern: Design is more utilitarian and less sleek than competitors.
options.best_for: Users valuing typing comfort and reliable performance over lightness.

options.name: Apple MacBook Air M1 2020
options.upside: Outstanding battery life and smooth performance with macOS ecosystem.
options.tradeoff: Limited to macOS software, which may complicate some development workflows.
options.concern: Compatibility issues with some Windows-based development tools.
options.best_for: Prioritizing battery life and seamless macOS experience.

options.name: HP Envy 15 Laptop
options.upside: Powerful CPU and dedicated GPU for smooth video editing and multitasking.
options.tradeoff: Heavier and shorter battery life than other options.
options.concern: Less portable, which may be inconvenient for frequent travel.
options.best_for: Users needing strong graphics performance and raw power.

shared_context: We are a team of exactly 2 people choosing one laptop model to standardize on for work.
Our budget per laptop is capped at $1500.
We need laptops that can handle software development and occasional video editing.

personas.name: Wyatt
personas.background: I often travel for work and need a laptop that can handle video editing while being portable enough to carry around easily.
personas.private_goal: I want a powerful laptop with a dedicated GPU to ensure smooth video editing and multitasking despite the extra weight.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
object to the main rival option with a concrete concern

personas.name: Wren
personas.background: I spend long hours coding and prefer a laptop with a comfortable keyboard and reliable performance for productivity.
personas.private_goal: I want a laptop that balances solid performance with typing comfort, even if it is a bit heavier and has shorter battery life.
